Clefable

Fairy

Kanto · Generation 1

Clefable is a Fairy-type Fairy Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1.3 m tall and weighs 40 kg. It evolves from Clefairy. Its highest base stat is HP (95), with a base stat total of 483.
